name: button
title: Button
description: Didact's foundational action primitive (@didact/ui, layers 1-2 of the 3-layer architecture): variants default/destructive/outline/secondary/ghost/link, sizes default/xs/sm/lg/icon/icon-xs/icon-sm/icon-lg, asChild via the unified radix-ui package's Slot. Reads @didact/theme's real tokens (bg-primary, text-primary-foreground, etc.) instead of hardcoded values -- see packages/ui/src/components/button.tsx and docs/interface-norms.md's Action hierarchy for the full rationale.
